cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Don't open that rent letter yet. Help me hang our new curtains.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The landlord wants an answer today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. He'll love how we're looking after the place. Let's get a photo of the curtains.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send him one and ask whether we're behind.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not with that carpet showing. Let's rearrange the room first. You move the sofa; I'll hold your phone.
